system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"My premium has been cancelled even though I have a receipt and paid for the month on the 26th of November. It won’t let me fix this and I am not happy."

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! Sorry to hear that. Can you DM us your account's email address? We'll take a closer look and help you out! /AI"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Requesting email publicly risks privacy; suggest private message instead."}
